name: Prism
feature_notes: Brassline adds nine themed reel symbols across Jungle Crown, Ruby Corsair and Midnight Express. All six catch bonuses open directly to the first wave and wait for the first catch. The cabinet explains an ordinary miss when three identical symbols land above or below the active line.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Existing Countercraft backend is active; this build requires idle-v1 service and SQL upgrade before customer kiosk use. No Ike publication configured at read-only audit. Old service is rejected by kiosk.

install_step: Open Brassline in Fleet Arcade. Pick Jungle Crown, Ruby Corsair or Midnight Express to see its new symbols. When a catch bonus opens, tap one of the moving prizes.
